lines: Round 21 on summer is closed as no pass: R1 3 of 10, R4 (motion) 3 of 10, R3 6 and 7, the jury 3 of 15 against a bar of 9; measures 19 of 19 green. Round 22 is summer's last.

Seven builders work one fix pass until 19:20 UTC: air, glass, miniature, tree, sand, stone, room. Two instructions of mine were wrong and are turned round (decision 159): the haze in the globe is raised and made cream, and the light on the table goes back to its settled line, a soft pool with a few broad bands.
The shader guards (nan4) are in main: strict on all eight keys moves no pixel by more than 1 level. The app is being built for a publish from the first pictures' commit 464ab64d.
phase 6: 14.78 h used of its 12.00 h box
allowance (after the review): 14.78 h used of 12.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: The crown, the approved on the left and ours on the right as Round 21 judged it: the approved's pads stand against lit cream haze, ours is one dark mass against dim air.
The base at one scale: the approved is pale wet sand raked by light from the back right, ours is flat tan.
The light on the table: both draw thin gold veins. The settled line asks ours for a soft pool with a few broad bands, so this goes back.
Still: summer landed hero, hd, review
